The broad market benchmark posted its worst session since July, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq had its worst day since June. The Dow Industrials bucked the trend and closed marginally higher. Mainland China's CSI 300 declined 1.76%, deepening its descent into a technical bear market. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 was 0.21% lower. Worries around artificial intelligence spending weighed down the market and dragged the U.S. tech sector to a 3% decline on the day. Nvidia dropped 4.4%, Alphabet fell 3.2%, and Advanced Micro Devices declined 8.1% as losses occurred in different parts of the technology sector. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC on Thursday he thought capital within the AI buildout was becoming scarce. "There's a scarcity of capital. The demand [for] the capital is much greater than the availability of the capital," Huang said when asked about the neocloud segment of the AI buildout, which is proving to be fragile. Ed Yardeni, president of Yardeni Research, described the AI trade on Thursday as a "bubble" but said that some depressurization wouldn't be all bad. "Taking some air out of the AI bubble is a good thing. Created inside SpaceX in 2017 and spun out a year later, Boring Co. says its mission is to "revolutionize transportation" by creating underground tunnels with stations where passengers can board and exit. Last month, Boring Co. raised $3 billion at a $23 billion valuation, with backing from the United Arab Emirates and a roster of other longtime Musk supporters. Boring Co. has announced about a dozen city projects, but its only tunnels currently open for public use are in Las Vegas, where passengers can travel in Tesla vehicles between the downtown convention center and various casino resorts using its Las Vegas Convention Center Loop. In July of last year, Boring Co. struck a deal to build about 20 miles of tunnels in Nashville, Tennessee. The Music City Loop, as it's known, is being designed to carry paying passengers between downtown and the airport in Tesla vehicles. The fast-tracked project sparked a partisan feud when it was greenlit and has drawn new safety concerns over sinkhole risks this week. In the UAE, Boring Co. plans to build over 150 kilometers (93 miles) of tunnels, including a project announced in February of last year, the Dubai Loop. SpaceX also said in Thursday's filing that it purchased $151 million worth of Tesla's Megapack energy storage systems during the quarter. Musk said on SpaceX's earnings call on Tuesday that he thinks it would be a "good idea" for the two companies to merge, and said they've both created special committees to discuss a potential transaction. headlines.article_text: Etsy bans AI-generated recipes, patterns from its online marketplace Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu Key Points Etsy said it's banning AI-made recipes, patterns and instructions from its online marketplace. The company also laid out clearer rules around AI usage on its platform, including barring sellers from creating bot-generated listings without any human involvement. User confusion around AI content on the platform has emerged as a "top-three barrier to shopping more often on Etsy," the company said. In this article ETSY Follow your favorite stocks CREATE FREE ACCOUNT The Etsy Inc. headquarters in the Brooklyn borough of New York on June 25, 2024. Victor J. Blue | Bloomberg | Getty Images Etsy said Thursday it will no longer allow merchants to sell AI-generated recipes and patterns on its online marketplace, as part of a wider push to set firmer rules around the use of artificial intelligence on its platform. In a blog post , Etsy said it's banning the sale of "functional guides" that are created using AI, including patterns, cooking recipes and instructions. The products are usually marketed as digital downloads, such as crochet or sewing patterns. Users then "put in effort to achieve a finished product," the company said. Sellers will also be required to show an actual item made using the instructions, not an AI-generated or simulated result, "so buyers know what to expect," Etsy said. Etsy said in a separate notice to sellers that it was making the changes as AI threatens to erode buyers' and sellers' trust in the platform. "Today, many active buyers say they can't tell which items involve AI-generated content," the company wrote. "It's become a top-three barrier to shopping more often on Etsy. And you, our seller community, have told us you're concerned about your work appearing alongside items that use AI in misleading ways, and that it's becoming harder for buyers to recognize your role in creating your items." As part of the move, Etsy said it's barring sellers from creating bot-generated listings without any human involvement. Sellers will also be required to include at least one unedited photo of the actual item they're selling. Etsy told sellers it will continue to allow AI-generated art on its platform as long as merchants "play a clear role in what they create and are transparent about the process." "Sellers must still disclose when an item is created using AI and cannot misrepresent AI-generated work as handmade or entirely their own creation," the company added. Founded in 2005, Etsy is known for its mix of craft makers and artisan goods. The company has been leaning more into that reputation as it has battled an influx of generic, mass-produced items from resellers and increasing competition from Amazon and Walmart , as well as newer e-commerce upstarts like TikTok, Temu and Shein. Misleading, AI-generated products or images present a new challenge for Etsy and other online marketplaces. Etsy has in recent years struggled to curb the proliferation of AI-made crochet patterns and other AI "slop." Amazon recently required sellers to label photos or videos that feature AI-generated people in response to recent legislation mandating the disclosure. While Etsy has cracked down on the use of AI in listings, it's been infusing the technology throughout more of its website. The company has used AI to build more detailed profiles of shoppers and surface relevant products in search results. Etsy has also partnered with OpenAI on shopping features, including launching a ChatGPT app for product discovery.
